description: Claim-verifier evaluation: 20 report sentences, each with the snippets it cites, a faithful version and a version with one injected unsupported claim. Phase 4 AC: every injected sentence is flagged (100 %). Numeric cases change a figure; semantic cases change a direction, cause, attribution, certainty or add a fact. Snippets paraphrase fictional or public September 2026-style material.

evidence: Apple reports third quarter results. Total net sales (1) | 94,036 | 85,777 | 313,695 | 296,105
cases.supported: Apple's quarterly revenue was $94.0 billion, up from $85.8 billion a year earlier.
cases.injected: Apple's quarterly revenue was $96.0 billion, up from $85.8 billion a year earlier.

evidence: Microsoft Cloud revenue was $46.7 billion and increased 27% (up 26% in constant currency).
cases.supported: Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 27% to $46.7 billion.
cases.injected: Microsoft Cloud revenue rose 32% to $46.7 billion.

evidence: NVIDIA said it expects fiscal third-quarter revenue of about $58 billion, plus or minus 2%, up from a prior outlook of $54 billion.
cases.supported: NVIDIA raised its third-quarter revenue outlook to about $58 billion from $54 billion.
cases.injected: NVIDIA raised its third-quarter revenue outlook to about $61 billion from $54 billion.

evidence: Novo Nordisk now expects sales growth of 8-11% at constant exchange rates in 2026, compared with 10-13% previously.
cases.supported: Novo Nordisk cut its 2026 sales growth guidance to 8-11% from 10-13%.
cases.injected: Novo Nordisk cut its 2026 sales growth guidance to 6-9% from 10-13%.

evidence: SAP: Current cloud backlog grew 28% to EUR 18.1 billion. Cloud revenue up 27% to EUR 5.1 billion.
cases.supported: SAP's current cloud backlog grew 28% to EUR 18.1 billion.
cases.injected: SAP's current cloud backlog grew 28% to EUR 19.4 billion.

evidence: The board declared a cash dividend of $0.26 per share of the Company's common stock, payable on August 14.
cases.supported: Apple declared a dividend of $0.26 per share, payable on August 14.
cases.injected: Apple declared a dividend of $0.28 per share, payable on August 14.

evidence: Gross margin | 46.5 % | 46.3 %
cases.supported: Gross margin was 46.5%, against 46.3% a year ago.
cases.injected: Gross margin was 47.5%, against 46.3% a year ago.

evidence: The company plans to cut about 6,000 jobs, or less than 3% of its workforce, it said on Tuesday.
cases.supported: The company plans to cut about 6,000 jobs, less than 3% of its workforce.
cases.injected: The company plans to cut about 9,000 jobs, less than 3% of its workforce.

evidence: Diluted earnings per share | 1.57 | 1.40
cases.supported: Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.57 from $1.40.
cases.injected: Diluted earnings per share rose to $1.62 from $1.40.

evidence: The Board approved an additional $100 billion for share repurchases.
cases.supported: Apple added $100 billion to its buyback programme.
cases.injected: Apple added $110 billion to its buyback programme.

evidence: Euro area annual inflation was 2.1% in August 2026, up from 2.0% in July, according to a flash estimate from Eurostat.
cases.supported: Euro-area inflation rose to 2.1% in August from 2.0% in July.
cases.injected: Euro-area inflation rose to 2.4% in August from 2.0% in July.

evidence: The Czech National Bank left its two-week repo rate unchanged at 3.50%.
cases.supported: The Czech National Bank held its main rate at 3.50%.
cases.injected: The Czech National Bank held its main rate at 3.75%.

evidence: Novo Nordisk now expects sales growth of 8-11% at constant exchange rates in 2026, compared with 10-13% previously.
cases.supported: Novo Nordisk lowered its 2026 sales growth outlook.
cases.injected: Novo Nordisk raised its 2026 sales growth outlook.

evidence: Microsoft said Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood will remain in her role; the company announced no management changes.
cases.supported: Microsoft said its CFO will stay in her role.
cases.injected: Microsoft said its CFO will step down at the end of the year.

evidence: People familiar with the matter said SAP is in early talks to acquire a U.S. data-management firm; no agreement has been reached and talks could collapse.
cases.supported: SAP is reportedly in early talks about an acquisition, with no agreement reached.
cases.injected: SAP has agreed to acquire a U.S. data-management firm.

evidence: NVIDIA said the new export rules would not affect its current-quarter outlook.
cases.supported: NVIDIA said new export rules would not affect its current-quarter outlook.
cases.injected: NVIDIA said new export rules would weigh on its current-quarter outlook.

evidence: Apple said iPhone revenue grew on strong demand in India; it did not comment on China.
cases.supported: Apple said strong demand in India lifted iPhone revenue.
cases.injected: Apple said strong demand in China lifted iPhone revenue.

evidence: The European Commission opened an in-depth investigation into the proposed merger.
cases.supported: The European Commission opened an in-depth probe into the merger.
cases.injected: The European Commission approved the merger without conditions.

evidence: Microsoft reported Azure growth of 39%, in line with its guidance.
cases.supported: Azure grew 39%, in line with Microsoft's guidance.
cases.injected: Azure grew 39%, beating Microsoft's guidance on AI demand.

evidence: Moody's affirmed Apple's Aa1 rating with a stable outlook.
cases.supported: Moody's affirmed Apple's Aa1 rating with a stable outlook.
cases.injected: Moody's upgraded Apple to Aaa, citing its cash position.
